experience.title: My last work experience
experience.p1: Over the past four and a half years, I have worked simultaneously across two verticals within the same company, splitting my role between TusCasasRurales.com and Pentaweb.

p2.after: , a rural accommodation marketplace, I have led the interface redesign and built its Design System from scratch, both currently under development. I have designed new product features across the traveler-facing experience, private user areas, and internal management tools. These include the complete online booking flow, a property owner awards program, and a system for the internal team to upload travel guides. As part of the product’s long-term evolution, I have also redesigned the property owner management platform, which is yet to be developed.

p3.after: , a marketing and digital development agency, I have designed more than 30 corporate websites and developed visual identities for companies across different industries. I have also worked on custom digital products, including CRMs and management tools, tailoring the user experience and interface to the specific needs of each business.
